name: minimum_spanning_tree
author: edba08e8
description: Computes the minimum spanning tree of an UNDIRECTED graph with Kruskal's algorithm: the cheapest set of edges that connects all nodes, using edge weights (every edge counts as 1 on unweighted graphs). Use for questions like 'cheapest way to connect all the sites?' or 'minimum total weight needed to link everything?'. Directed graphs return an error. On a disconnected graph it returns a spanning forest and reports the number of components. Returns total_weight, number of edges and the cheapest top_k tree edges (with node id and label), plus result_graph_id: a registered subgraph holding the whole tree, usable by other tools.

graph_id.description: Id of an undirected graph to analyse, e.g. 'lesmis' or 'karate'.

top_k.description: How many tree edges to list in the result (cheapest first). The full tree is always available through result_graph_id.
